resources.string: enter the PIN JAS shows on the laptop
laptop address (leave empty to find it)

The address is found on your network, so only the PIN is needed. Tap the button above. Android will ask for two things: the microphone, then permission to display over other apps. Allow both and tap it again — the face then floats on your home screen and listens.
Forget this laptop’s certificate? Only do this if JAS says it is not the laptop you paired with — normally you never need it.
Forgotten. Tap Show JAS on screen to pair again.
